attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: llm-text-cleanup-via-fastapi-proxy

steps:
  - id: receive_extracted_text
    op: receive_request
    params:
      source: pwa_frontend
      method: POST
      endpoint: /api/cleanup
      content_type: application/json
      expected_payload:
        - extracted_text
    output: raw_request

  - id: validate_cors_origin
    op: validate_origin
    params:
      request: "{{raw_request}}"
      allowed_origins:
        - "https://<username>.github.io"
      reject_on_mismatch: true
      error_response:
        status: 403
        body: "Origin not allowed"
    output: validated_request

  - id: forward_to_llm
    op: http_post
    params:
      url: "{{LLM_API_ENDPOINT}}"
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {{LLM_API_KEY}}"
        Content-Type: application/json
      body:
        model: "{{LLM_MODEL}}"
        messages:
          - role: system
            content: >
              Tu es un assistant de nettoyage de texte. Tu reçois un extrait de texte
              issu d'un livre numérisé. Supprime les numéros de page, les en-têtes
              courants, les notes de bas de page, et les artefacts de césure
              (traits d'union en fin de ligne avec mot coupé). Retourne uniquement
              le texte nettoyé, sans commentaire ni explication.
          - role: user
            content: "{{validated_request.extracted_text}}"
      timeout_seconds: 30
      no_storage: true
      no_logging_of_payload: true
    output: llm_response

  - id: receive_cleaned_text
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: "{{llm_response}}"
      field: choices[0].message.content
      trim_whitespace: true
    output: cleaned_text

  - id: return_cleaned_text
    op: send_response
    params:
      status: 200
      headers:
        Content-Type: application/json
        Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "https://<username>.github.io"
        Access-Control-Allow-Methods: POST
        Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type
      body:
        cleaned_text: "{{cleaned_text}}"
      no_data_retention: true
